note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: Q2 2026 printed above the top of both guide ranges: revenue $392.9M vs a $386-392M guide, AOI $43.3M vs $40-43M. The Q3 AOI guide of $44-47M implies only ~11% growth, against 24% in Q2 and 27% in H1. The FY AOI guide was narrowed to $176-184M rather than raised. A third straight top-of-range AOI print (~$47M+) plus an FY raise is the likely setup.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 beat plus the $100M buyback: +15.46%. Q1 2026 beat (EPS $0.11 vs $0.07): +1.42%. Q3 2025 revenue beat ($366.9M vs $362.3M) with an adjusted-profit miss on higher acquisition spend: -8.34%. The Feb 2026 FY-guide print: -13.01%. Beats alone have not been reliably bought; guidance direction decides.

findings.finding: The California Department of Insurance approved a 28.1% average rate increase for American Pet Insurance Company, Trupanion's California underwriter. It affects 94,326 policyholders (about 8% of 1.125M subscription pets) at renewals after 19 July 2026, and some policies rise more than 70%. Q3 subscription ARPU gets a partial-quarter lift; the retention metric (98.37% TTM in Q2) carries the churn risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: ARPU growth of +9% in Q2 2026 (pricing that tracks vet inflation) came with the +15.46% Q2 reaction. Retention has not surprised in either direction in the sourced history.

findings.finding: Lemonade's Q3 2026 shareholder letter (filed with the SEC on 4 Nov 2026 after the close, after Trupanion last spoke) shows the pet gross loss ratio at 75%, up from 74% in Q2 2026 and 69% in Q3 2025. Industry claim severity was still rising through Q3. Trupanion's own Q2 value proposition was 70.2% vs 71.1% a year earlier.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Trupanion's value proposition improved 90bp y/y in Q2 and the stock rose 15.46%. In Q3 2025 higher acquisition costs and investment drove an adjusted-profit miss and an -8.34% reaction. There is no sourced instance of the stock trading on a peer loss ratio.

findings.finding: IDEXX's Q3 2026 call (2 Nov 2026) put US same-store clinical visits at about -1.8%, worse than Q2's -1.3%, and said puppy and kitten adoption stays muted. This is the 'shrinking puppy vet-visit funnel' Piper used to downgrade TRUP on 26 Aug, and it bears on Trupanion's vet-referral gross pet adds (Q2 net adds of 18,800, +39% y/y).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Piper downgrade on this thesis moved the stock about -6% on 26 Aug 2026. On the Q2 print, net adds accelerated despite the industry visit decline the company itself acknowledged, and the stock rose 15.46%.

findings.finding: On 5 Aug Trupanion authorised a $100M opportunistic buyback (no expiry), backed by a $44M extraordinary dividend from APIC and 'just under $100 million of available operating cash'. The Q2 10-Q shows zero repurchases in H1. The stock then traded as low as $22.92 (Form 4, 28 Sep). The Q3 release or 10-Q is the first disclosure of whether and how much was bought near the lows; $100M is about 7% of today's ~$1.48B market cap.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The buyback authorisation was announced with Q2 and the stock rose 15.46%. Execution has never been disclosed before.

findings.finding: The Q3 guide assumed a 0.71 USD/CAD rate. The Canadian dollar traded at about 0.714 on 5 Aug, 0.725 on 20 Aug and 0.721 on 11 Sep, so a Q3 average near 0.72 gives a small FX tailwind to reported revenue: roughly 1.4% on the CAD-denominated book, about $1M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No sourced instance of the stock trading on FX.

findings.finding: The stock rose about 47% from $22.92 (28 Sep Form 4) to $33.74 at the seal, +30.7% in 20 days and +11.8% in 5. EDGAR shows no 8-K since 5 Aug, and no upgrade was found. The bar going into the print has risen with the price, on a name whose last Q3 print fell 8.3% on a revenue beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nov 2025 (Q3): -8.34% on a revenue beat with a profitability miss. Aug 2026: +15.46% after the stock had been weak into the print.

outside_window.finding: Trupanion and Pets Best will end their relationship after Q3 2028 (disclosed 5 Aug 2026); the other-business segment ($116.2M revenue, 1.6% AOI margin in Q2) winds down then.
The new digital insurance product is to launch around mid-2027 (midpoint of the current strategic plan), per the Q2 call.

lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): the guide-conservatism finding went from +1.5 to +1.0, because Q3 2025 and Q1 2026 beats were sold or barely bought.
Rule 6 (inside the guide): the California rate increase went from +0.3 to +0.2, because it was approved before the guide was set.
Rule 5 (a proxy is small): Lemonade went from -0.7 to -0.5 and IDEXX from -0.4 to -0.2 (the company had already acknowledged the visit decline); both are kept and filed.
Rule 5 (an absence of explanation is worth 0) and rule 7 (positioning): the unexplained run-up finding went from -1.0 to -0.5. It is kept because the run-up and the short covering are sourced facts.
Rule 5 (an inference is small): the buyback execution inference went from +0.5 to +0.4.
abs_move_pct (13.5) and p_up (51) are unchanged, so expected_move_pct stays 0.27.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 revenue is likely to land at about $50-60M against the $64.07M consensus (17 analysts; low $56.24M). Q2 HPC lease revenue was $31.9M, with only part of CB-3 contributing. Q3 has the full 102 MW at Lake Mariner (CB-3 delivered early July) but no material CB-4 rent: management said the first CB-4 hall would start generating lease revenue only in late September. Mining revenue was $12.8M in Q2, down 73% year on year, and is shrinking as capacity is repurposed. The bulk of the 2026 consensus ramp ($253M FY versus about $79M in H1) needs CB-4 rent that falls mostly in Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Confirmed earnings releases only (the baseline history is contaminated): Q2 2026 on 2026-08-05 missed revenue ($44.8M vs about $48.0M), stock -4.29%. Q1 2026 on 2026-05-08: -2.62%. Q4 2025 on 2026-02-26 (EPS miss): -9.28%. Q3 2025 on 2025-11-10: -13.5%. Q2 2025 on 2025-08-08: +1.82%. That is 4 of 5 down, with a median |move| of 4.3%. Peer Cipher Digital missed Q3 revenue by about 30% on 2026-11-02 and was roughly flat on the print day, so in this transition phase the revenue line has been only weakly punished.

findings.finding: The CB-4 schedule at Lake Mariner has already slipped once. In February 2026 the company targeted CB-4 energization in Q3 2026 and CB-5 in Q4 2026. On the Q2 call CFO Fleury said 'the revised commencement dates were mutually agreed with our tenant'. CB-5 moved to 'very early January' 2027, and the first CB-4 hall was due to start lease revenue in late September. No company release since then confirms that the first CB-4 hall delivered, so the print is the first place the market learns whether the late-September milestone held.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The CB-4/CB-5 revision went out with the Q2 release on 2026-08-05 (-4.29% that day, together with a revenue miss). Delivery news moved peers strongly: Galaxy rallied on its first Helios hall delivery. No clean WULF precedent on delivery timing alone.

findings.finding: Q3 GAAP results will carry a large non-cash gain: 77.7M warrants at a $0.10 weighted strike were carried at $1,816.7M at 2026-06-30, and the stock fell from $24.70 (June 30) to $14.80 (September 30). That implies roughly a $0.7B fair-value gain, plus about $80M of gain on the Abernathy JV sale ($530M price vs $450M cost, effective 2026-07-06). Headline GAAP net income and EPS will probably be positive against a -$0.38 consensus, the mirror of Q2's $755.7M warrant loss and -$1.94 EPS.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q2 2026 the warrant line went the other way (EPS -$1.94 vs about -$0.19 to -$0.24 consensus, headline 'miss'), and the stock fell 4.29% together with a revenue miss. Headline EPS mechanics have not visibly driven the close.

findings.finding: On 2026-11-04 TeraWulf announced Google credit support for the project debt at the 401 MW Justified campus (Anthropic leases, about $19B contracted), plus a definitive GMP-basis Fluor EPC. No financing size or Google terms were disclosed. The guarantee activates only as each lease commences, construction risk stays with TeraWulf and its lenders, development cost is estimated at $4-4.5B, and delivery runs from late 2027 'through Q2 2028' (the Q2 release said full delivery in early 2028). The stock fell 6.6% on 11-04 and a further 14% on 11-05. The Nov 6 call is the first chance to quantify debt size, cost and equity need.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Financing news has been sold. A $425M convert announcement traded -7% (cryptoslate), the revolver upsize on 2026-10-23 coincided with a six-month weekly low, and the Google backstop was sold on 11-04/11-05. Earlier, the August 2025 Google backstop of Fluidstack leases went +59.5% (baseline row 2025-08-14).

findings.finding: Positioning into the print is a crowded and rising short at a capitulation low. Short interest is 128.1M shares, 33.4% of float, with 3.91 days to cover, up from 119.4M the prior period. The stock is -60% from $24.70 at June-end to $10.02, at a 52-week low, after a sector-wide funding scare (Cipher -58% in a month, a Texas moratorium pledge that hits Texas-exposed peers more than WULF, which sold its Texas JV). 25 analysts rate it Strong Buy with a $31 average target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-11-03 the stock rose +14.5% intraday-to-close (10.94 to 12.53) with no company news found, showing how quickly the short covers. On 2026-10-15 it reversed from a $10.95 open to $12.62 on 108M shares.

findings.finding: Insider flow into the print is small and mixed. CEO Prager sold 137,500 shares at $17.06 on 2026-08-27 under a 10b5-1 plan (keeping about 40M shares), director Walter Carter sold 130,626 at $15.14 on 2026-08-31, and director Michael Bucella bought 6,085 at $14.79 on 2026-09-15. Form 144s were filed in September.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measurable reaction on WULF print days to insider flow.

findings.finding: The sell side cut targets sharply into the print while keeping Buy ratings: B. Riley $40 to $26 (2026-10-30), KBW $29 to $20 (2026-11-02), Bernstein $36 to $20 (2026-11-04). Morgan Stanley held $65 (2026-10-21). Expectations were lowered before the release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: KBW's July 2026 target cut coincided with a -10.5% day (2026-07-28/29). Cuts have been sold on the day, not after.

outside_window.finding: $280M of the $530M Abernathy (Texas) JV sale consideration is still receivable from the Fluidstack-led buyer group: $150M by 2026-12-31 and about $130M by 2027-04-30. A Texas data-center moratorium pledge by the governor-elect (reported 2026-11-04) could stress the buyer, though the call may only mention it.

Muskie (eastern Kentucky) contracted power was expanded to 1 GW, with initial service expected in Q4 2028 and financing 'probably first half of next year' per the CFO. It is long-dated and does not resolve in the window.

lessons_applied: Lesson 7 (crowded short shrinks negatives): revenue finding -1.0 to -0.8, CB-4 timing -0.75 to -0.6. Short interest is 33% of float and rising.

Lesson 3 (own caveat reaches the number): the Google backstop financing finding went from +0.75 to +0.5, because its own text notes activation only at commencement, an undisclosed GMP and a slight timeline slip.
Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown is worth 0): the positioning finding went from +0.75 to +0.5. The drawdown has a sector cause, so it stays as a squeeze mechanism, but smaller.
Lesson 2 (one-offs at a fraction): the warrant/Abernathy gain went from +0.3 to +0.25, with no path to guidance.
'If it is in the wire it is priced': the target-cuts finding went from +0.2 to +0.1.

The rule on untrustworthy history: the earnings base rate was rebuilt from 5 confirmed releases (median |move| 4.3%, 4 of 5 down). abs_move kept at 12, near the option-implied 13.04, per the core (sign uncertainty does not shrink it).

Lesson 6 (disputed bar): Yahoo $64.07M vs a Benzinga snippet of $83.6M. Findings that depend on the bar were already capped small; print_vs_bar revised from -10 to -12 after re-reading the FY consensus arithmetic.
